For my patients

Apps I recommend

Useful tools, not more digital clutter. Choose an app only when it solves a specific problem. You do not need to download everything here.

Your health record

MyChart ↗Message your care team, review results, manage appointments, and, when your health system enables it, enter home blood pressure or glucose readings.Some health systems use their own branded MyChart app.iPhone ↗Android ↗

Medications

MedisafeMedication schedules, refill reminders, and optional family-support notifications.iPhone ↗Android ↗

Food and nutrition

Dr. Greger’s Daily DozenA simple checklist of foods and activities from NutritionFacts.org and How Not to Die.iPhone ↗Android ↗
MyFitnessPalTrack calories, nutrients, meals, and activity when structured self-monitoring would help.Tracking is not helpful for everyone, particularly with a history of disordered eating.iPhone ↗Android ↗
FooducateScan foods, review ingredients, and compare alternatives.iPhone ↗Android ↗
FasticAn intermittent-fasting timer to structure eating windows.Discuss fasting first if you are pregnant, have an eating-disorder history, or use glucose-lowering medication.iPhone ↗Android ↗

Sleep, mood and focus

Insomnia Coach ↗A free VA app with a guided weekly plan, sleep diary, and tools based on CBT for insomnia.It does not replace evaluation or treatment for sleep problems.iPhone ↗Android ↗
Bearable ↗Track symptoms alongside sleep, stress, habits, and medications to spot patterns worth discussing.Patterns in an app suggest questions; they do not prove a cause.iPhone ↗Android ↗
Pomodoro timer25-minute focus intervals with planned breaks. Any simple timer works; no subscription needed.iPhone ↗Android ↗

Women and children

Flo ↗Track periods, symptoms, ovulation estimates, pregnancy, and perimenopause patterns.Predictions are estimates. Review privacy settings before entering sensitive information.iPhone ↗Android ↗
CDC Milestone Tracker ↗Track your child’s development from 2 months to 5 years, and know when to raise a concern.iPhone ↗Android ↗

Already on your phone

Limit screen timeScreen Time on Apple devices or Digital Wellbeing on Android shows patterns and sets limits.Apple instructions ↗Android instructions ↗
Reduce evening blue lightSchedule Night Shift (Apple) or Night Light (Android) as part of a wind-down routine.Apple instructions ↗Android instructions ↗
Update emergency informationAdd conditions, medications, allergies, and emergency contacts viewable while your phone is locked.Apple instructions ↗Android instructions ↗

Health apps are not your medical record. Before entering reproductive, symptom, medication, or mental-health information, review the app’s privacy settings and collect only what will help you. Do not rely on an app for emergencies or urgent medical advice.

The USDA’s Start Simple with MyPlate app has been retired. Use the MyPlate.gov website ↗ instead.

Educational information from Gennady Gelman, MD. Not medical advice for you; your own clinician can tell you what fits your health.

In an emergency, call 911. For a mental health crisis, call or text 988.
